title: Apple Health
pitch: Bring in your walks, runs, hikes and rides from Apple Health, Apple Watch workouts included, so their streets become your turf too. Activities you record here are saved to Health.
startTip: Workouts are brought in from the moment you connect. Older ones stay in Apple Health.
privacy: Health data stays on this phone (unless you include Apple Health workouts in Cloud backup). To stop CityTurfer reading or writing it, open the Health app › Profile › Apps › CityTurfer.
noWorkoutsHint: Nothing found? In the Health app › Profile › Apps › CityTurfer, allow Workouts and Workout Routes.
importing: {count, plural, one {Importing… # added so far} other {Importing… # added so far}}
